I am a lecturer in Mathematical Data Science at the [School of Mathematics](https://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/) and [Edinburgh Futures Institute](https://efi.ed.ac.uk/) at the University of Edinburgh since 2021. I joined the School of Mathematics as a University Teacher in Statistics in 2017. Previously, I completed my PhD in Statistics at the University of St Andrews, under the supervision of Michail Papathomas and Ruth King, working on identifiability and parameter redundancy of log-linear models fitted to sparse contingency tables.



Education Background:

-  PhD in Statistics, University of St Andrews
-  MSc in Mathematical Statistics, University of Tabriz
-  BSc in Statistics, University of Tabriz



Research Interests:

- Parameter redundancy
- Identifiability problem in statistical models
- Multiple systems estimation
- Applications of statistics in social sciences and psychology
- Statistics and data science pedagogy
